lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Hello,

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Teacher.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: It's Zwei.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I'm a student at M.M.R. Vocational School,

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: and a member of the School Circle Squad.
Hello, Zwei.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: This is the first time I'm sending you a personal message,

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: so I just wanted to say hi.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Anyway, I ought to get going.
Sure, keep in touch.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: By the way,

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: is it okay if I contact you

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: even if I don't have any special going on?
Of course.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: And can I ask you questions

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: that I don't know the answer to?
Sure, feel free to.
Zwei doesn't respond for a moment.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Okay then, I do have a question.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: If the coefficient of the highest term of the cubic function f(x) is 1

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: and it satisfies the following condition

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: regarding the function f(x), f(k-1)
Wait a minute.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Yes?
Is this math you're throwing at me?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Is that a bit too sudden?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Okay, then I'll ask you about another subject.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: It's a question about the Ark's history:

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: The achievements of the current Missilis CEO, Syuen,

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: can be summarised into three major points.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: The first is...
Hold on.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Yes?
History's not exactly my strong suit either...

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: What subject should I ask you about then?
How about combat?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: When encountering a Rapture in the city...

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Ah!

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Miss Marciana just arrived.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I'll go ask her.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Thanks, Teacher.
You're welcome to ask me too...
Zwei doesn't respond.
